title: Two more off-goal datasets passed the hardened subject check, and the signal that would have stopped them was already being computed and thrown away
symptom: The first scheduled round harvested five datasets: two useful (+8,208 labelled) and two off-goal (low-light street scenes, wheat heads), both arriving with labeled=0 and classes=0.
root_cause: A blocklist can only reject names it has heard of, and the allowlist matched 'drone' inside the uploader name dronefreak. BRAIN_STRICT, which rejects on under 50 labels or zero classes, defaulted to off.
correction_made: BRAIN_STRICT default-on in run_v3_0_43_brain_harvest_oneshot.sh; both zero-label sets quarantined with their measured reason.
